description: Phase 2: HTTP API — Hono server, JWT auth, sandbox CRUD, file operations, bash execution, and session manager. 24 stories across 6 epics.

userStories.title: Hono server bootstrap

acceptanceCriteria: src/api/server.ts creates and exports Hono app
JSON body parsing enabled
Request logging middleware (structured JSON: method, path, status, durationMs)
Global error handler: catches errors, maps FS error codes to HTTP status (ENOENT→404, EEXIST→409, EISDIR/ENOTDIR→400, EPERM→403, ENOTEMPTY→409), returns { error, code } JSON
GET /healthz returns 200 { status: 'ok' }
GET /readyz returns 200 { status: 'ok' } (basic check, DB health deferred to later)
Server listens on PORT env var (default 8080)
src/api/errors.ts exports mapFsErrorToStatus(err) helper used by global error handler
Unit test: healthz returns 200
Unit test: readyz returns 200
Unit test: unknown route returns 404
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Use @hono/node-server for Node.js runtime. Hono v4+.

userStories.title: JWT/HMAC auth middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I want auth middleware that verifies JWT tokens (HMAC-SHA256) signed with AUTH_SECRET and extracts the owner identity from the sub claim.
acceptanceCriteria: src/api/auth.ts exports Hono middleware function
Extracts Authorization: Bearer <token> header
Verifies JWT signature using AUTH_SECRET env var with HS256 algorithm via jose library
Rejects expired tokens (checks exp claim if present)
Extracts sub claim as owner identity, sets c.set('owner', sub) for downstream handlers
Returns 401 { error: 'unauthorized', code: 'AUTH_REQUIRED' } if token missing
Returns 401 { error: 'invalid_token', code: 'AUTH_INVALID' } if signature invalid or expired
Applied to all /v1/* routes (not /healthz, /readyz)
Uses jose library (zero-dependency JOSE implementation) — NOT jsonwebtoken
Unit test: valid token passes with correct sub extracted
Unit test: expired token returns 401
Unit test: tampered token returns 401
Unit test: missing Authorization header returns 401
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Install jose as dependency. AUTH_SECRET should be at least 32 bytes for HS256.

userStories.title: Session manager — get or create session
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the session manager to return one warm session per sandboxId or create it on demand, with per-sandbox serialization.
acceptanceCriteria: src/api/session-manager.ts exports SessionManager class
Internal Map<string, Session> keyed by sandboxId; Session contains { fs, bash, lastUsed, inFlight, mutex, state }
getOrCreate(sandboxId) checks Map; if found, updates lastUsed and returns existing session
If not found: calls createSandboxFs(backend, sandboxId), creates Bash({ fs }), stores new session
Single-flight: concurrent cache misses for the same sandboxId create exactly one session (use a pending Promise map)
withSession(sandboxId, fn) acquires per-sandbox async mutex, increments inFlight, calls fn(session), decrements inFlight on completion
Same-sandbox operations are serialized through the mutex — later requests wait for earlier ones
Constructor accepts { backend, databaseUrl?, createFs? } for dependency injection in tests
Unit test: first getOrCreate creates session, second reuses same instance
Unit test: two concurrent getOrCreate for same sandboxId create exactly one session
Unit test: two concurrent withSession calls execute sequentially (not in parallel)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Use async-mutex package (or hand-rolled Promise queue) for per-sandbox serialization. The mutex ensures pathCache/contentCache coherence.

userStories.title: Session manager — idle eviction
userStories.description: As a developer, I want idle sessions evicted after a configurable timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: Background interval (every 60s) checks lastUsed against SESSION_IDLE_MS (default 600000ms = 10 min)
Evicts sessions only when Date.now() - lastUsed > idleMs AND inFlight === 0 AND state !== 'closing'
Busy sessions past idle threshold are NOT evicted — reaper skips them
Eviction drops in-memory state only; does NOT call destroySandbox (sandbox data persists in DB)
startReaper() and stopReaper() methods for lifecycle control
Unit test: create session, advance time past idle threshold, verify evicted from Map
Unit test: busy session (inFlight > 0) past idle threshold is NOT evicted
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Use vi.useFakeTimers() in tests to control time advancement.

userStories.title: Session manager — pathCache memory budget
userStories.description: As a developer, I want each session's pathCache bounded by a configurable byte budget.
acceptanceCriteria: pathCacheMaxBytes configurable option, default 50MB per session
After fs.ready(), estimate total pathCache memory: sum of (path string bytes + ~100 bytes metadata overhead) per entry
Write/delete/move operations update the tracked byte estimate
If estimated pathCache size exceeds budget, session is marked non-retainable (overBudget flag)
Over-budget sessions are evicted when idle (inFlight drops to 0) regardless of SESSION_IDLE_MS
Under-budget sessions follow normal idle eviction rules
Unit test: under-budget session stays resident after operations
Unit test: over-budget session is evicted when idle
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: No partial path eviction — either the full pathCache fits in budget or the session is not retained.

userStories.title: Session manager — explicit destroy
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to explicitly destroy a session and its backend data.
acceptanceCriteria: destroy(sandboxId) marks session state as 'closing' immediately
New requests arriving after destroy started fail fast (withSession rejects with error if state === 'closing')
If session has in-flight work, destroy waits for active operation to finish before calling destroySandbox
After in-flight completes: removes session from Map, calls destroySandbox(backend, sandboxId)
No-op if session not in Map — still calls destroySandbox for DB cleanup
Concurrent destroy calls are idempotent; backend cleanup happens exactly once
Unit test: destroy removes session from Map and calls destroySandbox
Unit test: destroy waits for in-flight work before cleanup
Unit test: request arriving during destroy is rejected
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Use a Promise/resolve pattern to wait for inFlight to reach 0.
